transcript.t: Last summer, I went to Scotland with my family. We stayed in a small town in the countryside for a week.
The landscape was fantastic. There were green hills, blue lakes and old castles everywhere.
One morning, we walked in a forest and saw a group of deer. They were not afraid of us.
The weather was cool, and it rained a little almost every afternoon, so we always carried umbrellas.
In the evening, we ate soup in a warm restaurant. A man played the accordion, and everyone sang along.
It was a relaxing holiday, and I want to go there again.
